changes.content:
# House JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Unconstrained patterns keep identifiers,
# dates and serialized scalar data exact-match without changing accepted values.
retro_board:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    name:
      type: string
    description:
      type: string
    isLocked:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  required:
  - id
  - name
  - description
  - isLocked
retro_column:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    board_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    name:
      type: string
    description:
      type: string
    color:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    index:
      type: number
    visible:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
  required:
  - id
  - board_id
  - name
  - description
  - color
  - index
  - visible
retro_note:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    board_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    text:
      type: string
    column_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    stack_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    rank:
      type: number
    edited:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    votes:
      type: number
  required:
  - id
  - board_id
  - text
  - column_id
  - rank
  - edited
  - votes
retro_vote:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    board_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    note_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - board_id
  - note_id
